title: YrdenCraft
description: Optimization modpack, designed for Roleplay server.
body:
![YrdenCraft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b89aa35717cb8a24cdee287f216651ecf3550a02.png)

**YrdenCraft** is a mod pack for Minecraft 1.20.4 (Fabric), designed for players who value **realism, immersion and smooth gameplay.** It includes improved graphics, realistic sounds, new animations and strong optimization to make the Minecraft world more vivid and enjoyable to explore - without FPS drops. It's perfect for playing solo and with friends.

# 🔹 Key Mods Included
- **Sodium + FerriteCore + ModernFix** – High performance optimization
- **Distant Horizons** – LOD-based far terrain rendering
- **FirstPersonModel** – Full-body awareness in first person
- **SkinLayers3D** – 3D player skin rendering
- **Sound Physics Remastered** – Realistic reverb and occlusion effects
- **Drip Sounds** – Atmospheric ambient sounds
- **BetterThirdPerson** – Smooth 3rd-person camera
- **Xaero’s Minimap & World Map** – In-game mapping system
- **FancyMenu** – Fully customizable UI and menus
- **EntityCulling** + Enhanced Block Entities – Smart rendering performance boosts
- **Online Emotes + Serious Player Animations** – Expressive, dynamic character animations
- **NotEnoughAnimations** – Additional player animation polish
- **ChatWalk + MoreChatHistory** – UI quality-of-life improvements
- **Advancement Plaques** – Achievement visual enhancements
